name: Actionable Inline Notice
description: A restrained inline notice with semantic icon, optional dismissal and an async action that preserves its layout and reports failures honestly.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic icon; not a fabricated severity score.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Optional awaited action. Duplicate actions and dismissal are locked while it runs. Failure shows the current errorMessage and permits retry. Replaced alert content retires pending UI and ignores old replies. The pending action stays keyboard-focusable with aria-disabled; its synchronous guard prevents reactivation and completion does not reclaim focus from outside.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Optional synchronous host dismissal request. The caller removes the notice; dismissal is blocked while the current action is pending.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Current failure copy used when the active action rejects. Changing it does not retire the pending action.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
